scheme_name: Coaching Schemes For Sc/st/obc (non-creamy Layer) & Minority Students For Universities
other_conditions: Must be a university or college covered under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act and eligible for central assistance under Section 12(B).
Institution must have a sufficient number of Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Minority Community students to be considered for financial assistance.
Percentage of OBC (non‑creamy layer) and poor general candidates may be increased up to 40 % if enough SC/ST/Minority students are not available.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance to eligible institutions for non‑recurring items up to Rs 5 lakhs and recurring items up to Rs 7 lakhs per annum for coaching and related activities.
application_link: Step 01: The applicant needs to contact the Registrar/Principal. Step 02: Applications in the prescribed format are received from the concerned department. Step 03: The applicant must ensure that the filled information should be correct before submitting the application form to the concerned department. Step 04: After successful verification, the applicant can avail the benefit of the scheme.
